_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Closing workspace search with Escape resets the Archived filter. The server has the workspace feature on. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". The list is "active"; the archived list is "archived". "The search toggle" is the button "Search tasks...". Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Click the search toggle. 3. Click data-testid "archived-toggle". 4. [data-conversation-id="archived"] should be visible. 5. Close search: focus the query editor (data-testid "conversation-query-editor"; eval its focus()) and press Escape. 6. There should be no data-testid "conversation-query-editor"; the search toggle does not have the class "search-toggle-active"; there is no [data-conversation-id="archived"]; [data-conversation-id="active"] is visible. 7. Click the search toggle. 8. Data-testid "archived-toggle" has aria-pressed "false".
